reference.ordering: All speakers' lexical w elements sorted by start time, end time, speaker ID, then source order.
reference.normalization: Unicode NFKC, lowercase, normalize curly apostrophe, retain alphanumeric word tokens and internal apostrophes. Lexical fillers and truncated lexical w tokens are retained; punctuation w elements and non-lexical vocalsound/disfmarker/gap/comment events are excluded.
reference.overlap_limitation: A single-stream WER imposes a deterministic order on overlapping speakers; no overlap-aware scoring was attempted.
